description: Retrieval evaluation set: 40 questions a physical-design engineer asks about using OpenROAD / OpenSTA, written from general OpenROAD usage (not derived from the benchmark tasks). Each question is labeled with the command(s) that answer it and the source file(s) that document them (sources are paths relative to third_party/).
relevance: A retrieved chunk is relevant when its source equals (or ends with) one of the labeled sources AND its text or section mentions at least one labeled command as a whole word.
